description: Swings a Rifle weapon at a fixed target through the native attack-roll and damage-roll hooks and records each swing: the attack result and the physical damage rolled for a landed swing.
inputs: Attacker and target are two nw_bandit001, 8 m apart, the target held still; the attacker wields b_rifle (accuracy 18, evasion 18, weapon DMG 7, base item Rifle, properties [DMG/0/7/0, Delay/0/30/0, RequiresSkill/46/0/0, UnlimitedAmmunition/1/1/0]). Random is seeded with 20261039 once, then 30 swings are resolved in one step. Result 1 is a hit, 3 a critical hit, 4 a miss, 2 a deflection; damage is 0 unless the swing landed.
